description: This file defines API routes for exporting user pain-related data as FHIR resources within a FastAPI application. It includes endpoint handlers that query a database using SQLAlchemy async sessions, generate FHIR bundles and observations, and manage FHIR export records.

classes.name: FHIRExport
classes.description: ORM model representing a FHIR export record, including pain_event_id, fhir_resource_type, and fhir_data.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] export_fhir_bundle( current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handler that exports all pain events for the current user as a FHIR Bundle.

methods.name: FHIRExportInDB export_pain_event( pain_event_id: int, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handler that exports a specific pain event as an individual FHIR Observation and saves the export record.

ctags.name: export_fhir_bundle
ctags.signature: ( current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: export_pain_event
ctags.signature: ( pain_event_id: int, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
